2eac6af2-772c-40e1-91a4-fda334ed5d3e.incident_details: Loss date 2026-07-11. Hannah Brooks reports a burglary in which jewelry, rare coins, electronics, and artwork were taken from her residence. The rear door frame was damaged, but police found no usable prints. Hannah's inventory totals $99,000 and includes several recently acquired items paid for in cash. The theft category and date match active home coverage; ownership, valuation, recent acquisition, and possible policy limits require detailed review.
2eac6af2-772c-40e1-91a4-fda334ed5d3e.resolution_reason: Denied because the claimed ownership and value of material high-dollar items could not be substantiated and the inventory contained material inconsistencies.
